title: Design the v2 Current: looks, collections, sound, pace, and stage 2
acceptance: A dated design record (Class C) defines look on the Current (stage 1a) and, for stage 1b, per-segment collection, sound and pace, their lowering through the looks, and the membership gate; the three visual ids and nine themes stay.
The record also fixes the shape of stage 2's optional program field so stage 1 does not close it off.
The guide text the tool shows a model is written from the catalogue, never by hand.

evidence.note: The score, speech and service roadmap; Record.

summary: Score stage 1 as decided on 2026-10-06, in two halves: 1a adds look and nothing else; 1b adds collection, sound and pace, each with its own witness. Approach C over B, reasons recorded.
